   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 19, 2026 - Aug 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _David Atawal_, Jul 19, 2026, 2/5: "The app is not that bad, but there's so much to improve in, some issues I have with the app is the fact that there's no login feature which is very inconveniencing and could lead to lost of account especially when switching from the web version in Opera mini to the MiniPay app, and also the support is almost useless as they don't reply or attend to complaints"
            2. _Nalela Don William_, Aug 3, 2026, 4/5: "The app itself works quite well; transactions are generally fast, and the service is decent when it works. However, customer support is completely dead. I encountered a critical login issue and have been waiting for hours with absolutely no response. Good service means nothing if you can’t get help when your funds are locked. They need to fix their support system urgently."
            3. _Ekemini Samuel_, Aug 3, 2026, 4/5: "Hi Mini pay,just texting to tell you guys that there's a technical issue and it's very disturbing. Please,I would like you guys to look into the myriad app on the app and help fix the issue of being able to claim rewards (USD). I already tried contacting the app support contact but there's no reply and nothing has been done about it yet. Leaving that out,I hope that you guys could always continue the good work and do have a nice day...thanks and I hope to see the issue solved please 🙏"
